 General information and conditions: - 
 
1. Benefits under Council service: 
 
a. These posts carry usual allowances i.e. Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance 
(HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) etc., as admissible to the Central Government employees 
and as made applicable to CSIR  employees at the place of posting . Council employees are 
also eligible for  accommodation of the entitled type as per CSIR Resident Allotment Rules 
subject to the availability in which case HRA will not be admissible. 
 
b. In addition to the emoluments indicated against each category of post , benefits such as  
reimbursement of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession,  Children’s Education 
Allowances, Personal Computer Advance, and House Building Advance are available as per 
CSIR/Govt. of India (GoI) Rules as applicable to the Council Employees. 
 
c. All new entrants will be governed by the “National Pension System” or the Extant Pension

CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology Online Recruitment Portal Recruitment for Technical Officer Positions Detailed Advertisement: Advt. No. 04/2026 Online Application start date: 28th April 2026 11:00 AM Online Application closing date : 26th May 2026 11:59 PM Extended till: 5th June 2026 11:59 PM Last date for receipt of hard copy of application: 5th June 2026 06:00 PM Extended till: 15th June 2026 06:00 PM For Registered Candidates Contact / mail at recruitment.ccmb@csir.res.in for any queries. Instructions Please read the instructions carefully before applying Important recommendation: This online application is optimized for computer based browsers only and may not function properly in mobiles/tablets/ipads or other such devices. Therefore applicants are suggested to use computer based browser only to submit the application. Registration Candidates desirous to apply for Technical Officer positions against the advertisement should apply through this Online Recruitment Portal only. Candidates have to register with a valid Email Address by clicking on the "New Registration" button on the left side panel. Upon successful registration, the Registration ID and Password will be sent to candidate's registered email address. This Registration ID and Password is important for accessing Online Application Form. Candidates desirous to apply for more than one position need to register freshly with a same/different email address and fill the Online Application Form and proceed further. Application Fee Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupee Five Hundred only) through State Bank Collect under the payment category of "CSIR-CCMB Advt No 04/2026" only. The transaction number & E-receipt generated after successful payment of fee is required to be mentioned & upload in the online application. Pay through SB Collect Please select payment category " CSIR-CCMB Advt No 04/2026 " Application Form filling Login with Registration ID and Password to access the application form and fill the information. The Online Application Form has 5 pages Personal Details Educational Qualifications Details Employment Details Payment Preview & Submission Candidates should fill the correct information and will be held responsible for any typographical or other errors in data feeding. Later no request will be entertained for correction. Before filling the Online Application Form, Candidates have to keep the scanned copy of clearly visible recent passport size photo and signature Candidates can Login any number of times and navigate across the pages 1 to 5 to fill or update information. Please use "Save Details" button to preserve the filled in information. After filling information in all the pages, please click the "Final Submit" button in 'Preview & Submission' Page to submit the application Please note that once application is submitted, candidates will not have access to edit any information in Online Application Form. : 
 
 
 
 
NOTICE INVITING APPLICATIONS FOR EMPANELMENT OF 
CANDIDATES AS PROJECT STAFF PURELY ON TEMPORARY BASIS  
The CSIR -CCMB, Hyderabad,  invites a pplications from eligible 
candidates for empanelment as project staff in broad research areas 
of Cell/ Molecular biology/ Structural biology/ Ecology & evolutionary 
biology as below: 
 
Essential qualification & Experience 
Upper Age limit: 35 years 
i) Masters/ Integrated Masters  Degree in Natural or 
Agricultural or Pharmaceutical  Sciences OR bachelor’s 
degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a 
recognized University or equivalent. 
WITH/ WITHOUT Desirable number of years of experience 
in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic 
Institutions or science and Technology Organizations and 
Scientific activities and services. 
 
Upper Age limit: 40 years 
ii) Doctoral Degree in Science/ Pharma/ MD/ MS OR Masters/ 
Integrated Masters degree in Engineering or Technology from 
a recognized University or equivalent. 
        WITH/ WITHOUT Desirable number of years of experience    
        in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic           
        Institutions or science and Technology Organizations and  
        Scientific activities and services.  
 
 
 
 
CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, Hyderabad (CSIR -CCMB) is a premier 
Research Institute under the aegis of Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), 
an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. 
It is a leading research organization in frontier areas of modern biology and invo lved in 
conducting high quality basic research and training in multidisciplinary areas of modern 
biology and to seeking potential applications of the work. 
 
General terms and conditions: 
 
1 How to apply Candidates who fulfill the qualifications and 
experience are required to fill up the ONLINE 
APPLICATION format by clicking on the following 
link……..  
 
The name of the candidate in the application form must 
be the same as mentioned in the certificate of class X. 
In case the candidate has changed his name 
subsequent to Class X, t he evidence to that effect 
should be furnished at the time of interview. 
 
Candidates with last semester result awaited or 
incomplete degrees are not eligible to apply. 
 
For any technical problem while submitting the online 
application, candidates may write to psr@ccmb.res.in  
 
Last date to submit application through online: 11th 
May 2026. 
 
2 Empanelment Empanelment means the shortlisted candidates will be 
in the panel of CSIR -CCMB for six months from the 
date of result . This notification is for creation of a 
panel.  The panel shall be in alphabetical order and not 
to be construed as order of merit .  The selection for 
empanelment does not confer any right to candidate to 
claim for engagement as pr oject staff / regular staff . 
Candidates may be called only as per requirement of 
CSIR-CCMB, Hyderabad. 
 
3 Mode of 
empanelment 
This involves two stages: 
i) Screening of applications by a committee 
duly constituted by the competent authority 
for shortlisting eligible candidates.  
ii) Interview (Online/offline) of the shortlisted 
candidates by a selection committee duly 
constituted by the competent authority  for 
Empanelment. 
 
The date, time and venue of the interview will be 
notified in due course through email only. 
 
4 Engagement  The engagement of empanelled candidates purely on 
temporary basis with the approval of Competent 
Authority shall be based on requirement in the projects 
and availability of funds. The tenure may be extended 
or curtailed based on the conduct and the performance 
of the incumbent as well as requirement of the 
institute. However, the engagement shall be co -
 
terminus with the duration of the project or decision of 
the competent authority, whichever is earlier.  
The engagement of project staff in different projects 
either in same Lab/Instt. or different Lab./Instt. of 
CSIR taken together shall not exceed 5 years in any 
case. 
 
5 Payment On engagement as project staff, payment of 
emoluments shall be as per CSIR guidelines  or 
applicable funding agency guidelines issued from time 
to time with the approval of the Competent authority. 
 
6 Age  Relaxation in the age limit for the candidates belonging 
to the cat egory of SC/ST/PwBD/Women and the 
category of OBC shall be 05 years and 03 years 
respectively or as per Govt. of India instructions issued 
in this regard from time to time.  Age will be calculated 
as on the last date of receipt of online applications. 
(Age will be calculated as on the last date of receipt of 
online applications.) 
 
7 Experience The period of experience in a discipline / area of work 
shall be counted after the date of acquiring the said 
educational qualifications. 
 
8 Leave The incumbent would not be entitled to any kind of 
regular leave. However, they would be allowed for one-
day Leave for each completed month  in the event of 
their engagement as project staff. 
 
9 TA/DA No TA/ DA admissible for attending test/interview, 
joining the position. 
 
10 Office timings/ 
Working hours 
The incumbent is required to perform the assigned 
duties during working hours i.e. from 9:30 AM to 6:00 
PM on working days. The incumbent will not be allowed 
to take up any other assignment during the period of 
engagement. He /She may be required to work on 
Saturday/Sunday/other Gazetted holidays and 
beyond working hours also if need be. 
 
11 Tax deduction 
at source 
The Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted, 
as per the prevailing rules will be deducte d at source 
before effecting the payment.  
12 Confidentiality 
of data and 
documents 
The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) of the data 
collected as well as the deliverables produced for the 
office shall remain with this office. No one shall utilize 
or publish or disclose or part with, to a third party, any 
part of the data or statistics o r proceedings or 
information collected for the purpose of this 
assignment or during the course of assignment for the 
 
office, without the express written consent of the office. 
The incumbent shall be bound to hand over the entire 
set of records of assignmen t to the Office before the 
expiry of the contract, and before the final payment is 
released by the office. 
 
13 Termination of 
Service 
The performance of project personnel would be 
reviewed periodically so that candidates not found up 
to the mark, could be terminated. The engagement may 
be terminated at any time by the office without 
assigning any reasons by giving a one month notice. In 
case, the person desires to leave the assignment, 
he/she may also do so by giving one month notice or 
payment of one month stipend in lieu of, which can be 
condoned/ curtailed/ extended depending upon the 
discretion of the Competent Authority. 
 
14 DISCLAIMER Candidates who are applying for any of the above areas 
shall ensure that they fulfill the essential 
qualifications. In case they are found not fulfilling the 
essential criteria or that they have provided misleading 
information, then their candidature for the post may 
be rejected at any stage of empanelment or after 
selection by the competent authority. 
 
15 Disqualification Canvassing in any form and / or bringing any influence 
political or otherwise will be treated as a 
disqualification for the post. 
 
    
Controller of Administration

Uppal Road, Habsiguda, Hyderabd 500 007 Telangana  
Notification Number: 0226/D Date: 27.02.2026 
 
Applications are invited from the eligible Indian National for temporary position (s) on contractual 
basis as indicated hereunder. Candidates who fulfill the criteria should apply online at 
www.ccmb.res.in. For any technical problem while submitting the online application, may contact 
proj-rectt@ccmb.res.in. 
 
Last date to submit application through online: 09 March, 2026 
 
I) Name of Post: ANRF Junior Research Fellow (Project JRF) 
 Total Number of positions: 01 
   Upper Age limit (years): 35 
   Monthly Emoluments: Rs.37,000 + HRA 
 
Post code/ No. of 
Positions/ Area 010226D- 01 Position - Molecular biology 
Project Code/ Title GAP0587 
Comprehensive investigation of Bacterial and viral pathogens 
Essential Qualification  
M.Sc in Life Sciences/  Chemistry from a recognized University or 
equivalent AND selected through a process described through anyone 
of the following: 
a. National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship 
(Assistant Professorship) and GATE  
b. The selection process through National level examinations 
conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies 
and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, 
ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc.  
Desirable / Job description 
Working experience in a lab and having molecular biology skills such 
as Nucleic acid isolation and purification, PCR, gel electrophoresis, 
Sanger sequencing, and cloning would be preferable. Genomic/ RNA 
seq Library preparation for Next-Generation sequencing and analysis 
would also be advantageous. 
Name of the PI Dr. Vinay K Nandicoori 
Project end date 24th June 2027 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
II) Name of Post: ANRF Senior Project Associate (Senior - PAT) 
    Total Number of positions: 01 
    Upper Age limit (years): 40 
  Monthly Emoluments: Rs.57,000 + HRA 
 
Post Code/ No. of 
Positions/ Area 020226D - 01 Position – Molecular biology 
Project Code/ Title GAP0587 
Comprehensive investigation of Bacterial and viral pathogens 
Essential Qualification 
MSc / Integrated MSc in life sciences and FOUR years experience in 
molecular and cellular biology lab OR MTech and TWO years 
experience OR PhD  
 
Desirable / Job 
description 
Minimum 2 years of working experience in a lab and having molecular 
biology skills such as Nucleic acid isolation and purification, PCR, gel 
electrophoresis, Sanger sequencing, and cloning would be preferable. 
Genomic/ RNA seq Library preparation for Next-Generation sequencing 
and analysis would also be advantageous 
Name of the PI Dr. Vinay K Nandicoori 
Project end date 24th June 2027 
 
III) Name of Post: ANRF Technical Assistant 
  Total Number of positions: 01 
     Upper Age limit (years): 35  
Monthly Emoluments: Rs.27,000+HRA  
Post Code/ No. of 
Positions/ Area 030226D - 01 Position – Molecular biology  
Project Code/ Title GAP0587 
Comprehensive investigation of Bacterial and viral pathogens 
Essential Qualification Bachelor's degree in science / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & 
Technology 
Desirable / Job description 
 
Candidates with experience in lab management, indenting and 
administrative work in a research lab will be preferred. 
Name of the PI Dr. Vinay K Nandicoori  
Project end date 24th June 2027 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 General terms and conditions:  
 
 
1 How to apply Candidates who fulfill the criterion to fill up the ONLINE APPLICATION 
format by clicking on the following link……..   
2 Number of posts Director, CCMB reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of 
positions and also cancel the recruitment process for the positions 
mentioned above at any stage of the recruitment process.  The decision 
of the Director, CSIR-CCMB will be final and binding. 
3 Age relaxation Age relaxation as per CSIR/Govt. of India guidelines.  Age will be 
calculated as on the last date of receipt of online applications. 
4 Awaiting result/ 
Pursuing degree 
Those candidates who are still pursuing/ awaiting result for their degree 
M.Sc./ B.Tech./ PhD or any other qualification for the above post(s) as 
on the date of application will not be considered.  
5 Eligibility criterion Candidate should note that non -fulfillment of the eligibility criterion will 
result in cancellation of candidature at any stage 
6 Experience The period of experience in a discipline / area of work, wherever 
prescribed, shall be counted after the date of acquiring the minimum 
prescribed educational qualifications prescribed for that post. 
7 Screening of 
applications 
The applicants will be subjected to short  listing by CCMB 
scientists/designated committee according to the current requirement 
and the candidate’s shortlisted for interview will be displayed on CCMB 
website. 
8 Selection procedure The candidate(s) shortlisted by CCMB scientists/designated committee 
have to appear for interview in person/online before  the Selection 
Committee.  The  date, time and venue of the test/interview will be 
notified in due course through email only. 
9 Result / Panel for 
waitlisted candidate 
Based upon the performance of candidates in the interview, result of 
selected candidates against the number of post available in the project 
for each post code, will be declared and posted on CCMB website.  A 
panel of waitlisted candidates in order of mer it will also be formed for 
each post code, which will be valid for one year.  The panel may be 
operated on the recommendation of Project Investigator for meeting out 
any future r equirement in the project arises  due to resignation of 
incumbent/ non -joining of selected candidates/ further 
unforeseen/urgent requirement of project manpower for the same 
position in same project. 
10 Engagement The engagement shall be initially for a short duration based on 
availability of funds which may be extended or curtailed based on the 
conduct and the performance of the incumbent as well as requirement 
of the institute.  However, the engagement will not be beyond the tenure 
of the project and shall expire automatically on the expiry of project 
tenure, in which candidate has been selected.  The engagement under 
projects does not confer any right/claim whatsoever, either explicitly or 
implicitly on the appointee for regular appointment in CSIR/CCMB, 
against any post or otherwise under any legal conditions or precedent. 
The eng agement of project staff in different projects either in same 
Lab/Instt. or different Lab.Instt. of CSIR taken together shall not exceed 
5 years in any case.  
11 Leave The incumbent would not be entitled to any kind of regular leave. 
However, they would be allowed for one-day Leave for each completed 
month. 
12 TA/DA No TA/ DA admissible for attending test/interview, joining the position. 
13 Office timings/ Working 
hours 
The incumbent is  required to  perform the assigned duties during 
working hours i.e. from 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days. The 
incumbent will not be allowed to take up any  other assignment during 
the period of engagement. He /She may be required to  work on  
 
Saturday/Sunday/other Gazetted holidays and beyond working hours 
also if need be. 
14 Tax deduction at source The Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted, as per the 
prevailing rules will be  deducted at source before effecting the 
payment. 
15 Confidentiality of data 
and documents 
The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) of the data collected as well as 
the deliverables produced for the office shall remain with this office. 
No one shall utilize or publish or disclose or part with, to a third party, 
any part of the data or statistics or proceedings or information collected 
for the purpose of this assignment or during the course of assignment 
for the office,  without the express  written consent of the office.  The 
incumbent shall be bound to hand over the entire set of records of 
assignment to the Office before the expiry of the contract, and before 
the final payment is released by the office. 
16 Termination of Service The performance of project personnel would be reviewed periodically 
so that candidates not found up to the mark, could be terminated.  The 
engagement may be  terminated at any time by the office without  
assigning any reasons by giving a one month notice. In case, the person 
desires to leave the assignment, he/she may also do so by giving one 
month notice or payment of one month stipend in lieu of, which can be 
condoned/ curtailed/ extended depending upon the discretion  of the 
Competent Authority. 
17 DISCLAIMER Candidates who are applying for any of the above post shall ensure that 
they fulfill the essential qualifications.  If they apply without fulfilling the 
essential qualifications then it will be considered that they are giving 
wrong/misleading information.  The ONUS OF THIS ACTION WILL BE 
ON THE CANDIDATE and not on the Institute.  In case they are found 
not fulfilling the essential criteria or that they have provided misleading 
information, then their candidature for the post may be rejected at any 
stage of selection or after selection. 
18 Disqualification Canvassing in any form and / or bringing any influence political or 
otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post. 
 
Controller of Administration

prescribed, shall be counted after the date of acquiring the minimum 
prescribed educational qualifications prescribed for that post.

applications

scientists/designated committee according to the current requirement 
and the candidate’s shortlisted for interview will be displayed on CCMB 
website.

have to appear for interview in person/online before  the Selection 
Committee.  The  date, time and venue of the test/interview will be 
notified in due course through email only.

waitlisted candidate

selected candidates against the number of post available in the project 
for each post code, will be declared and posted on CCMB website.  A 
panel of waitlisted candidates in order of merit will also be formed for 
each post code, which will be valid for one year.  The panel may be 
operated on the recommendation of Project Investigator for meeting out 
any future r equirement in the project arises  due to resignation of 
incumbent/ non -joining of selected candidates/ further 
unforeseen/urgent requirement of project manpower for the same 
position in same project. 
10 Engagement The engagement shall be initially for a short duration based on 
availability of funds which may be extended or curtailed based on the 
conduct and the performance of the incumbent as well as requirement 
of the institute.  However, the engagement will not be beyond the tenure 
of the project and shall expire automatically on the expiry of project 
tenure, in which candidate has been selected.  The engagement under 
projects does not confer any right/claim whatsoever, either explicitly or 
implicitly on the appointee for regular appointment in CSIR/CCMB, 
against any post or otherwise under any legal conditions or precedent. 
The engagement of project staff in different projects either in same 
Lab/Instt. or different Lab.Instt. of CSIR taken together shall not exceed 
5 years in any case.  
11 Leave The incumbent would not be entitled to any kind of regular leave. 
However, they would be allowed for one-day Leave for each completed 
month. 
12 TA/DA No TA/ DA admissible for attending test/interview, joining the position. 
13 Office timings/ Working 
hours 
The incumbent is  required to  perform the assigned duties during 
working hours i.e. from 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days. The 
incumbent will not be allowed to take up any other assignment during 
the period of engagement. He /She may be required to  work on  
 
Saturday/Sunday/other Gazetted holidays and beyond working hours 
also if need be.

payment.

and documents

17 DISCLAIMER Candidates who are applying for any of the above post shall ensure that 
they fulfill the essential qualifications.  If they apply without fulfilling the 
essential qualifications then it will be considered that they are giving 
wrong/misleading information.  The ONUS OF THIS ACTION WILL BE 
ON THE CANDIDATE and not on the Institute.  In case they are found 
not fulfilling the essential criteria or that they have provided misleading 
information, then their candidature for the post may be rejected at any 
stage of selection or after selection. 
18 Disqualification Canvassing in any form and / or bringing any influence political or 
otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post.
